name: calliope
description: EPUB library manager and metadata editor for a self-hosted ebook library (web + Android).

scripts._comment:build:packages: Dependency order is derived from each package's @calliope/* deps by scripts/build-packages.mjs — no hand-maintained wave list. A new package needs no edit here: drop it in packages/, declare its deps, done.
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @calliope/backend && npm run build -w @calliope/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n tsc,backend,web -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev:tsc" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:web"
scripts._comment:dev:tsc: Both the backend and Vite import @calliope/* packages from their dist/, so without this watcher an edit in packages/* is invisible until dev restarts. build:packages runs first to verify tsconfig references and give the servers a dist/ to start from; the watcher then rebuilds only what an edit touches. The glob picks up a new package with no edit here.
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts._comment:gate: The pre-push gate. Runs format/lint/build/typecheck/tests and decides from the diff whether this change can break the *image* (a package.json, the lockfile, the Dockerfile, CI) and therefore needs the local `docker build` too. CI's image build always runs the full suite regardless.

_comment:engines: node:sqlite landed in 22.5 (behind an ExperimentalWarning) and is stable in 24. The image runs 24; this host runs 22, which works. Raise this to >=24 once the host is upgraded.
